description: Workspace-level session event stream vocabulary (migration_disposition §3 G-B, formerly M3/M4). Single source for api/domain/tensor_common.EVENT_KINDS; before m4964 the tuple was hand-written, so adding a word meant editing code in one branch and the TensorPhysics task-level emitter in another. Rule (one fact, one source): TensorPhysics TaskEvent (task-level stream) never inserts into tensor_agent_session_events; it cross-references the platform stream through the run manifest, and the only row writer on the platform side is api.domain.tensor_common.insert_event_row. Any new word needs a version bump plus green contract tests here and on the TensorPhysics side; a word added on either side alone is a red test, not a review comment.
